utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, still on. I’m just finishing a quick errand and then I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — what do you need for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, can you remind me what time we’re leaving? I might’ve missed the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re leaving at 7:30, right after the school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Pia — I haven’t heard any carpool updates yet, but I can ask around and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — could you let me know as soon as you hear? I’m just trying to sort out the timing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and tell you as soon as I hear anything about the timing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you tell me where you’ll be picking everyone up and what time you’ll start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can start at my place on Maple around 7:15, then swing by the corner near the park and your house after that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m putting together the carpool—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate that. Please save me a spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down. I’ll send the details once I firm up the route.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m just getting the carpool lined up. What days or times do you need a ride?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Rosa — weekday mornings around 8:00 would help most. Afternoons are usually flexible.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll note weekday mornings around 8:00 for you. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll adjust the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the carpool details again so I can make sure I have them right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — it’s the usual carpool, and I’m usually the late one. I’ll send the exact pickup time and route again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please send the exact pickup time and route when you can, and I’ll double-check I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — what time does Mara need the carpool to work around?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can work with either 8:00 or 8:30, whichever is easier for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:30 works better for us, thanks — we can do that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest yet — what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m checking with everyone now — I’ll send out the carpool plan as soon as I have the final headcount.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — thanks for checking. I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sounds good — what time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, can you do 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey! Maybe around 7:30 if that works for you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. I can be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the carpool plan—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: How about 7:30 tomorrow morning? I can keep track of who’s bringing what too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: 7:30 tomorrow morning works for me, and I can help keep everyone on the same page about who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Rey — any updates on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Ira, not yet — I’m still checking with a couple people. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, thanks — just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I’m still good to help, if we’re talking about tomorrow? Just remind me the time again and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Tomorrow works for me — I’ll just need the pickup time again, and I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — what time did we settle on for the pickup again?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just need to swap my pickup day this week. I can still do the other days.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — which day do you want to swap to?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be great, Gus. Let’s keep it simple — I can do Monday and Wednesday, and we can sort the rest tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good to me, Eli — I’ll take a look at the rest tomorrow and we’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, I can help with the carpool—what days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! I’m thinking weekdays around 8:00 AM and 3:30 PM—does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that should work for me. Send me the pickup details and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I can help coordinate the carpool—what time works best for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’m tracking everyone’s locations, so I can check who’s closest and line up a good pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send me the closest pickups, and I’ll line up the route and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the carpool organized and make sure everyone has the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on supplies and let folks know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll send out the pickup details and keep everything on track. Thanks, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there was a change with the carpool, but I’m not sure of the details yet. What did you hear, Mina?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I heard the pickup time moved earlier by 15 minutes. Did the route change too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure about the route yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do drop-off in the morning, and if you can handle pickup, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can handle pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times do you need covered?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you can do weekdays, right? And what time window works for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, weekdays work for me. I’m usually available from about 7:30 to 9:00 in the morning.
